title: Formwork JSON Studio
summary: A client-side JSON formatter, validator, anonymiser and mock-data generator. Nothing leaves your browser.

caseStudy.problem: Developers often paste sensitive JSON into online tools just to format or check it. Formwork does all of it locally, so no data ever leaves the browser.
caseStudy.role: Designed and built the whole app, from blueprint and interface sketch to deployment.
approach: Format, validate and auto-fix JSON, with plain-English error explanations instead of cryptic messages
Anonymise names, emails and phone numbers recursively across the JSON
Generate 100 mock entries matching the input's shape, downloadable as a file
Live analytics (size, depth, arrays, key/value pairs), PrismJS syntax highlighting and three themes
Built in vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no frameworks
caseStudy.outcome: A fast, privacy-first JSON toolkit deployed on Vercel.

title: Aqua AI: Water Demand Forecasting
summary: An AI-powered dashboard that predicts and analyses water demand, with next-day forecasts, alerts and recommendations.

caseStudy.problem: Water use was planned reactively. Forecasting demand in advance makes proactive resource planning possible.
caseStudy.role: Built during the 1M1B AI for Sustainability internship.
approach: End-to-end ML pipeline: preprocess, train, predict, recommend
Next-day water demand prediction from historical consumption data
Interactive Streamlit dashboard with Plotly demand-trend charts
Alerts and recommendations generated from the predictions
caseStudy.outcome: A live dashboard that turns consumption data into forecasts and actionable recommendations.
